annotations.title: Undo a decision on an attack surface item

description: Undo an open "It's handled" or "Meant to be public" decision, whoever made it, so the item is back in Needs you. A decision already closed, for example as fixed, cannot be undone. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator, who must be a member or above.

decisionId.description: The decision's id, from list_attack_surface_needs or list_attack_surface_decisions.

name: undo_attack_surface_decision
